hero.subtitle: Leyla is your AI mental wellness companion — private, judgment-free and always here for you. Talk, express, get support and feel better, at your own pace.

features.title: Features
features.naturalConversationsDesc: Talk like you would with a real friend — in any language.
features.proactiveCheckInsDesc: Optional messages to know how you're doing.
features.personalizedSupportDesc: Advice, exercises and tools that fit you.
features.crisisResourcesDesc: Get help when you need it most.
features.hundredPercentFreeDesc: Because mental health support should be for everyone.

howItWorks.title: How Leyla Works?
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple. Personal. Always with you.
howItWorks.step1Desc: It's free and takes less than a minute.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Share whatever is on your mind.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Track progress and build a healthier you.

friend.title: A friend who checks on you —
friend.description: With your permission, Leyla can send gentle check-ins to see how you're doing. Because sometimes, a small "Hey, how are you?" can make a big difference.
friend.multiLangSubtitle: Including English, Hindi, Telugu, Tamil and more...

cta.title: Healing is a journey.
cta.subtitle: You don't have to do it alone.
